UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 1213 
TO BE ANSWERED ON 11th FEBRUARY, 2022 
 
Cold Water Fisheries 
1213.  SMT. AMBIKA SONI: 
 
Will the Minister of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying be pleased to state: 
(a) whether Government has formulated any scheme for promotion of cold water fisheries 
by scientific methods; 
 
(b) if so, the  details thereof; and 
 
(c) the fresh steps taken by Government for developing post harvest, transport, promotion  
and branding facilities for species like Rainbow Trout in cold water areas of the country 
?  
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF FISHERIES, ANIMAL HUSBANDRY AND DAIRYING 
 
 
 (SHRI PARSHOTTAM RUPALA) 
 
(a) to (c): Yes Sir. The Department of Fisheries, Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and 
Dairying is implementing a flagship scheme namely Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana 
(PMMSY) with a highest ever investment of Rs. 20, 050 crore for a period of 5 years with 
effect from 2020-21 to 2024 -25 in all the States/Union Territories. PMMSY inter-alia 
provides support for promotion of cold water fisheries with a special focus on establishment 
of Trout Fish hatcheries, construction of raceways, inputs for Trout rearing units, construction 
of new ponds,, establishment of Recirculatory Aquaculture system(RAS), establishment of 
cages for culture of fish and also post-harvest infrastructure facilities. 
During 2020-21 and current financial year(2021-22),  project proposals at a total 
outlay of Rs.19586.27 lakh have been  approved for development of cold water fisheries  
including post- harvest development, transportation, promotion and branding facilities of 
Rainbow Trout. UT/State-wise details of proposals approved/funds released is furnished at 
Annexure-I.

Micro food processing Enterprises (PM FME) scheme in Maharashtra since its inception; 
 
(b) how much fund has been allocated so far by the Central Government under this scheme; 
 
(c) the number of proposals currently pending with Government and by when they will 
besanctioned; and 
 
(d) whether any target has been fixed by the Ministry under PM FME scheme for the Stateof

(c): Currently, no proposals are pending with the MoFPI from Maharashtra under the 
PMFME scheme. 
 
(d): Target of 22,234 individual units in respect of Maharashtra has been fixed for 5 years, 
from 2020-21 to 2024-25.

 RAJYA SABHA 
 UNSTARRED QUESTION No- 1215 
ANSWERED ON- 11.02.2022 
  
ALLOCATION OF FUNDS UNDER PM FME TO TAMIL NADU 
  
1215. SHRI M. MOHAMED ABDULLA: 
  
Will the MINISTER OF FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state: 
  
(a) the amount of funds allocated, disbursed and utilised under Pradhan Mantri  
Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises (PM FME) scheme for the State of 
Tamil Nadu for the year 2021-22; 
  
(b) whether the Central Government has any plans for the formalisation of cold storages 
andsea food processing industries under PM FME scheme across the coastal area of Tamil 
Nadu; and 
  
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not, the reasons therefor?  
 
ANSWER 
 
 THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES  
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
  
(a): A total amount of Rs.15.32 crores has been released including Rs.2.38 crores during 
current financial year 2021-22, out of which Rs.6.90 crores till January, 2022 have been utilised 
by the State of Tamil Nadu under the PM Formalization of Micro food processing Enterprises 
(PMFME) Scheme. 
  
(b) & (c): The following financial, technical and business support is provided under PMFME 
scheme for setting up/ upgradation of micro food processing enterprises and also 
establishment of Common infrastructure in the country including Tamil Nadu: 
  
(i). Support to Individual Micro Enterprises: Credit -linked capital subsidy @35% of the 
eligible project cost, maximum ceiling Rs.10 lakh per unit;  
  
(ii). Support to FPOs/ SHGs/ Producer Cooperatives: Credit linked Grant @35% to support 
clusters and groups such as FPOs/ SHGs/ Producer Cooperatives along entire value chain for 
sorting, grading, storage, common processing, packaging, marketing, testing etc.  
  
(iii). Support for Common Infrastructure: Credit linked grant @ 35% to support FPOs, SHGs, 
Cooperatives, any Government agency or private enterprises for Common infrastructure.  
  
(iv). Branding and Marketing Support: Grant upto 50% for Branding and Marketing to 
groups of FPOs/ SHGs/ Cooperatives or an SPV of micro food processing enterprises for 
Market study, Product standardisation (including quality assurance), Packaging material, 
Graphic designing, warehousing/ storage rentals, Pr omotional activities, Training related to 
Sales & Marketing and Trademark registration.

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO- 1216  
                  ANSWERED ON- 11.02.2022 
TESTING LABS FOR FOOD PRODUCTS 
1216. SHRI RAM CHANDER JANGRA:       
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state: 
               
(a) the number of the testing laboratories for food products in the country and the number 
of laboratories which are operational; 
  
(b) whether all these laboratories have been established according to the international 
standards; 
 
(c) if not, whether any scheme is under consideration for upgradation of these laboratories, 
if so, the details thereof; and 
                      
(d) the number of laboratories proposed to be established in various States including 
Haryana in the coming five years?  
ANSWER 
  
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
  
(a) & (b) : There are 726 Testing Laboratories for food products in the country as per study 
conducted by Ministry of Food Processing Industries in 2020 -21 and these Laboratories are 
operational at different levels of operation and testing of food products. Out of these, 585 food 
testing laboratories have obtained Accreditation as per the international standards i.e. ISO/IEC 
17025/NABL.   
(c): There are three central sector schemes implemented by Government of India, wherein 
financial assistance is provided to establis h/upgrade Food Testing Laboratories to meet with 
international standards i.e. ISO/IEC 17025/NABL. The three central sector schemes are (i) 
Food Safety and Quality Assurance Infrastructure implemented by Ministry of Food Processing 
Industries, (ii) Strength ening of Food Testing System in the Country including provision of 
Mobile Food testing Lab implemented by Food Safety and Standards Authority of India under 
Ministry of Health and Family Welfare and (iii) 
Financial Assistance for Quality Development Scheme  implemented by Agricultural and 
Processed Food Products Export Development Authority under Ministry and Commerce and 
Industries.  
(d): Government of India does not establish any Food Testing Laboratory on its own. The 
proposal for Food testing Laboratories received are demand driven and there is no specific state 
wise target. The details of Food Testing Laboratories supported in the State of Haryana are at 
Annexure.

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO- 1217 
ANSWERED ON- 11.02.2022 
  
DEVELOPING TAMIL NADU INTO A FOOD PROCESSING HUB 
  
  
1217. SHRI P. WILSON: 
 
Will the Minister of Food Processing Industries be pleased to state:  
 
(a) whether Government is planning to develop Tamil Nadu as a food processing hub, if so, 
the details thereof; 
 
(b) whether Government has details of the food processing projects being set up across the 
country especially in Tamil Nadu; 
  
(c) the quantum of funds allocated and the amount sanctioned by  Government as on date 
and the progress of the industry in Tamil Nadu; and 
 
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not, the reasons therefor?  
  
 
ANSWER 
 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
  
(a) to (d):  The Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) is implementing the Central 
Sector Umbrella Scheme- Pradhan Mantri Kisan SAMPADA Yojana (PMKSY) for, inter alia, 
creation of modern i nfrastructure and efficient supply chain for facilitating food preservation 
and processing across the country including Tamil Nadu. So far, Ministry has approved a total 
of 79 infrastructure projects in the state under corresponding component schemes of PM KSY, 
which includes 1 Mega Food Parks, 16 Cold Chain projects, 11 Agro Processing Clusters, 22 
Food Processing Units, 9 Backward & Forward Linkages Projects & 20 Food Test Laboratories. 
The details of these projects along with Grants approved and Grants re leased is placed at 
Annexure. 
 
           Also, as part of the Aatmanirbhar Bharat Initiative, MoFPI is implementing a Centrally 
Sponsored Scheme -PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises Scheme 
(PMFME) for providing financial, technical and business support for setting up/upgradation of 
2 lakh micro food processing enterprises across the country through credit linked subsidy during 
five years from 2020-21 to 2024-25.  Out of this, a total of 12128 units have been allocated to 
Tamil Nadu for five years and a total of Rs 15.33 Crore has been released to the state, so far.

 RAJYA SABHA 
 UNSTARRED QUESTION NO- 1219 
 ANSWERED ON- 11.02.2022 
  
PRODUCTION LINKED INCENTIVE SCHEME 
  
1219. SMT. SHANTA CHHETRI 
  
Will the Minister of Food Processing Industries be pleased to state: - 
  
(a) whether an outlay of Rs. 10,900 crores to support creation of global food manufacturing 
champions and support Indian brands of food products in international market has been planned 
by the Ministry under Production Linked Incentive (PLI) scheme; 
 
(b) if so, the details thereof, if not, the reasons therefor; and 
  
(c) how much of the outlay has been invested and progress of implementation year -wise 
and State-wise?  
  
 
ANSWER 
 
  
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
         
(a) to (c) : Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Food Processing Industry (PLISFPI) has 
been formulated by the Ministry as part of “Aatma Nirbhar Bharat Abhiyaan” for enhancing 
India's manufacturing capabilities and e nhancing exports with an outlay of Rs 10,900 crore. 
The scheme has three broad components. The first component relates to incentivizing 
manufacturing of four major food product segments viz. Ready to Cook/ Ready to Eat (RTC/ 
RTE) including millet -based foo ds, Processed Fruits & Vegetables, Marine Products and 
Mozzarella Cheese. The second component is intended for incentivizing Innovative/ Organic 
products of SMEs across all the above four food product segments including Free Range - Eggs, 
Poultry Meat and Egg Products.  The third component relates to support for branding and 
marketing abroad to incentivize the emergence of strong Indian brands. 
  
The scheme guidelines were notified on 2nd May, 2021 and EoI was issued for inviting 
applications under the scheme on 2 nd May, 2021 with closure date of application window as 
24th June, 2021.  A total of 60 applicants under Category-I, 12 applicants under Category-II and 
71 applicants under Category-III have been selected recently.

SCHEME FOR FORMALISATION OF MICRO FOOD PROCESSING ENTERPRISES 
  
1221. SHRI K.R.N. RAJESHKUMAR: 
  
Will the MINISTER OF FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state: 
  
(a) whether Government has proposed/launched any scheme for formalisation of micro 
food processing enterprises with an outlay of Rs.10,000 crore for providing credit linked 
subsidy to 2 lakh micro food processing units across the country; 
  
(b) if so, the details thereof; 
  
(c) whether Government has fixed any target for strengthening infrastructure of the industry 
across the country; and 
  
(d) if so, the details thereof including the financial support to the State Governments in this 
regard? 
   
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES  
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
  
(a) & (b): Yes Sir. Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) is implementing a centrally 
sponsored "PM Formalisation  of Micro food processing Enterprises (PMFME) Scheme" for 
providing financial, technical and business support for upgradation of micro food processing 
enterprises in the country. The scheme is operational for a period of five years from 2020-21 to 
2024-25 with an outlay of Rs 10,000 Crore. Support to upgrade existing units or setting up of 
new micro units for individuals is provided through a credit linked grant @ 35% with maximum 
grant of Rs. 10.00 lakhs. The Scheme also provides support to food processing  units of Self 
Help Groups (SHGs) / Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) / Cooperatives for credit linked 
subsidy@35%, Seed Capital to SHGs, Incubation Centre, Common Infrastructure, Marketing 
& Branding and Capacity Building.  
 
(c) & (d): The following targets have been fixed for strengthening infrastructure under Pradhan 
Mantri Kisan Sampada Yojana (PMKSY) scheme during 15 th Finance Commission Cycle 
(Financial Year: 2021-22 to 2025-26):

FDI IN FPI SECTOR 
 
 
1222. SHRI RAKESH SINHA: 
           
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state: 
 
(a) how much F oreign Direct Investment (F DI) has been received in the F ood Processing 
Industry (FPI) sector since 100 percent FDI was allowed in the sector in India; 
 
(b) the big giants which invested in food processing in India; and 
 
(c) the share of food processing sector in total credit to industry since 1990? 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
 
(a): Foreign Direct Investment policy and data is looked after by Department for Promotion of 
Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT). The total FDI received in the food processing sector since 
April 2000 till November 2021 was US$ 10.88 billion. 
  
(b): As per information received from DPIIT, some of the major companies that invested in the 
Indian food processing sector includes ; B.S.A. INTERNATIONAL , Belgium;  CADBURY 
SCHWEPPES MAURITIUS LTD , Mauritius; UNILEVER PLC, United Kingdom; Orkla Asia 
Pacific Pte Ltd , Singapore; DANNONE AS IA PACIFIC HOLDINGS LTD , Singapore; 
ROQUETTE FRERES, France; RELAY B.V., Netherland; PEPSICO PANIMEX INC, Mauritius, 
etc. 
 
(c): Data related to credit is released by the Reserve Bank of India. Accordingly, the share of 
credit to food processing sector in total credit to industry since 1990 till March 2021 was 5.37% 
(approx.).

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
RAJYA SABHA 
 UNSTARRED QUESTION NO- 1223   
ANSWERED ON- 11.02.2022 
  
ASSISTANCE TO FPIs IN KARNATAKA  
  
1223. SHRI IRANNA KADADI: 
  
Will the Minister of Food Processing Industries be pleased to state : 
  
(a) whether Government has provided assistance to Food Processing  Industries (FPIs) in 
Karnataka during the last two years and the current year; 
 
(b) if so, the details thereof, industry and location-wise; 
 
(c) whether Government has fixed any time limit for  accepting the proposals  and providing 
assistance; 
 
(d) if so, the details thereof; and 
 
(e) whether Government has taken any steps to reduce the prescribed time limit and if so, 
the details thereof?  
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
  
(a) to (e): The Ministry of Food Processing industries (MoFPI) has been implementing Central Sector 
umbrella scheme - Pradhan Mantri Kisan SAMPADA Yojana  (PMKSY) for overall growth and 
development of food processing sector across the country including Karnataka. Under component 
schemes of PMKSY, MoFPI provides mostly credit linked financial assistance (capital subsidy) in 
the form of grants-in-aid to entrepreneurs for setting up of food processing / preservation industries. 
So far, Ministry has approved 2 Mega Food Park projects, 16 Cold Chain projects, 4 Agro Processing 
Clusters, 18 Food Processing Units, 3 Creation of Backward & Forward Linkages Projects & 9 Food 
Test Laboratory projects in  Karnataka for assistance under corresponding component schemes of 
PMKSY. Details of these projects along with location is placed at Annexure. 
 
MoFPI is also implementing a Centrally Sponsored Scheme - PM Formalisation o f Micro 
Food Processing Enterprises Scheme (PMFME) for providing financial, technical and business 
support for setting up/upgradation of 2 lakh micro food processing enterprises across the country 
through credit linked subsidy during five years from 2020-21 to 2024-25 with an outlay of Rs. 10,000 
cr.  Out of this, a total of 11910 units have been allocated to Karnataka and Rs 49.93 Crore has been 
released to the state so far. 
 
PMKSY is not any region or state specific but demand driven and financial assista nce is 
provided to the eligible applicants selected on the basis of Expression of Interest (EoI) issued from 
time to time. Selection of suitable proposals is done regularly as per the Scheme guidelines, based on 
the merit, through a transparent appraisal p rocess as per the prefixed criteria. As selection process 
involves appraisal & scrutiny of proposals at multiple levels, including through Inter -Ministerial 
Approval Committee (IMAC), no specific time limit is prescribed in this regard in PMKSY, though 
MoFPI makes every effort for its expeditious disposal. Grants to assisted projects is disbursed 
immediately after achieving prescribed benchmarks within budgetary constraints.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO- 1224 
ANSWERED ON- 11.02.2022 
 
SELLING OF TOP CROPS AT LOWER PRICE 
 
1224. SHRI NEERAJ SHEKHAR:  
 
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government is aware that farmers of Eastern Uttar Pradesh, particularly the 
districts of Ballia and Ghazipur produce Tomato, Onion and Potatoes (TOP) on large scale but 
they are compelled to sell it every year at price lower than the cost of production; 
  
(b) if so, the details of thereof; and 
 
(c) the details of steps Government would take to provide remunerative price to these tomato, 
onion and potato growing farmers of Eastern Uttar Pradesh during the current crop season? 
    
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI PRAHLAD SINGH PATEL) 
 
(a) to (c): Ballia and Ghazipur district of Utttar Pradesh are figuring in the list of major producing 
districts for onion only as per the Report titled “Horticulture Statistics at a Glance 2018” published 
by the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare.   These districts are, accordingly, selected as 
eligible clusters/districts for onion crop as pe r the existing guidelines for the short term 
intervention under the Operation Greens scheme.     
 
The Ministry of Food Processing Industries provides transportation /storage subsidy @  
50% for notified fruits & vegetables  (including Tomato, Onion and Potato (TOP) crops) in 
selected clusters at the time of glut situation during harvest season under short term intervention. 
The provision of transportation/storage subsidy helps in evacuation of surplus production of crops 
from production centres to consumption centres and ensures price stabilization for farmers as well 
as consumers.   
 
The Ministry is also maintaining Market Intelligence & Early Warning System (MIEWS) 
Portal to keep watch on current prices of Tomato, Onion and Potato (TOP) crops through National 
Agricultural Cooperative Marketing Federation of India Ltd.  (NAFED) and , accordingly, low 
price alerts are issued to concerned States from time to time. 
 
The D/o Agriculture & Famers Welfare implements a Market Intervention Scheme (MIS) 
for procurement of agricultural and horticultural commodities which are perishable in nature and 
for which Minimum Support Price (MSP) is not announced. The scheme objective is to protect 
the growers of these commodities from making distress sale in the event of a bumper crop during 
the peak arrival period when prices tend to fall below the economic  levels/ cost of 
production.  The scheme is, however, implemented at the request of a State/ UT Administration 
which is ready to bear 50 % of the loss (25 % in case of NER), if any, incurred on its 
implementation.

Automobile and Auto Components, which was approved on 15 th September 2021 with a 
budgetary outlay of Rs. 25,938 crore for a period of five years.

 GST on electric vehicles has been reduced from 12% to 5%; GST on chargers/ charging 
stations for electric vehicles has been reduced from 18% to 5%.

RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 1229 
ANSWERED ON 11.02.2022 
 
ENSURING EASE OF DOING BUSINESS 
 
1229. DR. VINAY P. SAHASRABUDDHE: 
 
Will the
 Minister of Heavy Industries be pleased to state: 
 
(a) the various initiatives undertaken by the Ministry and its constituent bodies towards 
ensuring Ease of Doing Business for the industries relevant to the mandate of Ministry, the 
details thereof; 
 
(b) whether the Ministry has documented the extent of ease brought to the industries in 
doing business through these initiatives, if so, the details thereof, if not, the reasons therefor; 
and 
 
(c) whether the Ministry and its constituent bodies consult with relevant stakeholders for 
improving the efforts towards increasing Ease of Doing Business, if so, how and if not, the 
reasons therefor? 
 
ANSWER 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR HEAVY INDUSTRIES 
(SHRI KRISHAN PAL GURJAR) 
 
(a): Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) under the Ministry 
of Commerce & Industry, the nodal Department for providing Ease of Doing Business 
(EoDB) has informed that they, in coordination with C entral Ministries/Departments and 
Governments of States/Union Territories (UTs), have taken several reform measures with an 
aim to improve regulatory environment and facilitate doing business in India.   This is evident 
from three major initiatives spearheaded by DPIIT focusing on – World Bank’s Ease of Doing 
Business, State Business Reforms Action Plan and systematic approach to reduce co mpliance 
burden on businesses and citizens.   The steps taken intend to benefit all the sectors/industries 
of an economy, including the Heavy Industry.  
 
DPIIT regularly coordinates with nodal Ministries/Departments/States concerned to 
monitor the exercise for improving India’s ranking in World Bank’s Doing Business Report 
(DBR).  As a result of these efforts, India ranks 63 rd in the latest DBR, 2020 released in 
October, 2019, registering a jump of 14 ranks over its previous rank.  
DPIIT has been anchoring a dynamic reform exercise called Business Reforms Action 
Plan (BRAP), which ranks all the States and UTs in the country based on implementation of 
designated reform parameters. 
DPIIT is the Nodal Department for coordination with Ministries/Departments and 
States/UTs to reduce compliance burden on citizens and business activities.   The objective of 
this exercise is to improve Ease of Doing Business and Ease of Living by  Simplifying, 
Rationalizing, Digitizing and Decriminalizing Government to Business and Citi zen Interfaces 
across Ministries/States/UTs.  The key focus areas of the exercise are: 
a. Rationalization/Auto-renewal of licenses / certificates / permissions. 
357

-2- 
 
b. Risk-based / Third-party Inspections and Audits. 
c. Standardized and simplified return filing. 
d. Rationalized maintenance of registers. 
e. Minimize / eliminate display requirements. 
f. Digitization and simplification of manual forms and records. 
 
(b): DPIIT has informed that under BRAP exercise, the  reforms implemented by 
States/UTs are uploaded on the BRAP  Portal (https://eodb.dpiit.gov.in/).  Further, as part of 
reducing compliance burden exercise, DPIIT launched Regulatory Compliance (RC) Portal to 
record the datasets of compliances and track action taken to reduce them by the Ministries and 
States/UTs on 1st January, 2021 (https://eodbrcp.dipp.gov.in/).  Based on data uploaded on 
RC Portal, more than 27,000 compliances have been reduced by Centra l 
Ministries/Departments and States/UTs combined as on 07.02.2022, as part of this exercise. 
 
(c): As part of reducing compliance burden exercise, DPIIT conducted stakeholder 
consultations with various Industry Associations to identify the compliances in various 
sectors.  Industry Associations have also been provided access to the Regulatory Compliance 
Portal to enter details of burdensome compliances for necessary corrective steps by 
Ministries/Departments and States/UTs concerned.

 PLANS OF INDIAN RAILWAYS 
 
1239.  DR. SASMIT PATRA:  
 
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to state:  
(a) the details of the future plans that the Indian Railways has for itself; 
(b) how will it benefit the citizens; and 
(c) the reforms that the Indian Railways is proposing to bring in the coming days to further streamline 
and develop itself? 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF RAILWAYS, COMMUNICATIONS AND 
 ELECTRONICS & INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY 
 
(SHRI ASHWINI VAISHNAW) 
 
(a) to (c) : A Statement is laid on the Table of the Sabha. 
 
****** 
 
370

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (c) OF UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 
1239 ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA ON 11.02.2022 BY DR. SASMIT PATRA REGARDING 
 PLANS OF INDIAN RAILWAYS 
 
(a) to (c) : Indian Railways have prepared a National Rail Plan (NRP) for India – 2030. The Plan is to 
create a ‘future ready’ Railway system by 2030.   The NRP is a imed to formulate strategies based on 
both operational capacities and commercial policy initiatives to increase modal share of the Railways 
in freight to 45%. The objective of the Plan is to create capacity ahead of demand, which in turn 
would also cater t o future growth in demand right up to 2050 and also increase the modal share of 
Railways to 45% in freight traffic and to continue to sustain it. To achieve this objective all possible 
financial models including Public Private Partnership (PPP) are being considered.  
As Indian Railways is the growth engine of the nation, NRP is aimed to reform Railways to make 
it more efficient, greener and modern which will translate into cheaper, safer and assured mode of 
transport to the common man be it in passenger or freight segment. To achieve this objective, 
following main features of the National Rail Plan have been identified:- 
 Formulate strategies based o n both operational capacities and commercial policy initiatives to 
increase modal share of the Railways in freight to 45%. 
 Reduce transit time of freight substantially by increasing average speed of freight trains to 
50Kmph. 
 As part of the National Rail Pl an, Vision 2024 has been launched for accelerated implementation 
of certain critical projects by 2024 such as 100% electrification, multi -tracking of congested routes, 
upgradation of speed to 160 kmph on Delhi -Howrah and Delhi-Mumbai routes, upgradation of speed 
to 130kmph on all other Golden Quadrilateral -Golden Diagonal (GQ/GD) routes and elimination of 
all Level Crossings on all GQ/GD route. 
 Identify new Dedicated Freight Corridors. 
 Identify new High Speed Rail Corridors. 
 Assess rolling stock requirement for passenger traffic as well as wagon requirement for freight. 
  Assess Locomotive requirement to meet twin objectives of 100% electrification (Green Energy) 
and increasing freight modal share. 
 Assess the total investment in capital that would be required along with a periodical break up. 
 Sustained involvement of the Private Sector in areas like operations and ownership of rolling 
stock, development of freight and passenger terminals, development/operations of track infrastructure 
etc.

376

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (e) OF UNSTARRED 
QUESTION NO. 1243 BY DR KIRODI LAL MEENA ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA ON 
11.02.2022 REGARDING RAILWAY LAND 
(a)  to (c):  As on 31.03.2021
, the total  land available with the Indian Railways  is 4.84 
lakh hectares out of which 4.22  lakh hectare land is under operational and allied usages and 
0.62 lakh hectare (approximately)  land is vacant.  This vacant land is mostly in the form of 
narrow strips along tracks and is utilized for servicing and maintenance of track, bridges and 
other infrastructure. The vacant land is also utilized for execution of various infrastructural 
projects for meeting future growth needs of Railways which include projects like 
doubling/tripling and traffic facilities works, etc. Railways’ operations also necessarily require 
development of ancillary logistic support/infrastructure such as bulk oil installations and oil 
depots, steel yards, concrete sleeper plants, coal dumps, connectivity to private sidings, 
connectivity to ports and other infrastructure, commercial plots, vending stalls, etc. for which 
land is leased/licensed. The Railways do not maintain market price of land as it is governed by 
various factors and keeps on fluctuating.  
(d) and (e):  Out of 4.84 lakh hectare land available with Indian Railways, approximately 
810.31 hec
tare land (0.17%) is under encroachment. For prevention/removal of 
encroachments, Railways carry out regular surveys of encroachment and take action for their 
removal. If the encroachments are of temporary nature (soft encroachments) in the shape of 
jhuggies, jhopris and squatters, the same are removed in consultation with and the assistance of 
Railway Protection Force and local civil authorities.  For old encroachments, where party is 
not amenable to persuasion, action is taken under Public Premises (Eviction of Unauthorized 
Occupants) Act, 1971 (PPE Act, 1971), as amended from time to time.  Actual eviction of 
unauthorized occupants is 
carried out with the assistance of State Government and police.

SETTING UP OF HEALTHCARE INFRASTRUCTURE ON RAILWAY LAND 
 
 
1251. 
SHRI BIRENDRA PRASAD BAISHYA:  
              
            
      
      Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether 91 locations have been identified, which include New Bongaigaon and Rangapara for a 
pilot project of setting up territory level multi speciality hospital under North East Frontier 
Railway (NFR);  
(b) if so, the details thereof indicating location-wise present status as well as recommendation made, 
if any, by the Transaction Advisor for this project; and  
(c) if not, the reasons therefor? 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF RAILWAYS, COMMUNICATIONS AND  
ELECTRONICS & INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY 
 
(SHRI ASHWINI VAISHNAW) 
 
 
(a) Yes, Sir. During the Budget Speech of 2010-11, it was announced to set up 381 OPD & 
Diagnostic Centres, 101 Secondary Level General Specialty Hospitals and 40 Tertiary Level 
Multi-Specialities Hospitals (including New Bongaigaon and Rangapara North) in collaboration 
of MoH&FW. A High Power Working Group with senior officials of both the Ministries under 
the Chairmanship of Minister of State for Health & Family Welfare had identified 91 locations 
including 50 OPD & Diagnostic Centres, 25 Secondary Level General Specialty Hospitals and 16 
Tertiary Level Multi-Specialities Hospitals for a pilot project. 
387

(b) & (c) A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was signed between Ministry of Railways and 
Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (MoH&FW) on 05.02.2010 as per which MoH&FW was to 
establish OPD & Diagnostic Centres, Secondary Level General Specialty Hospitals and Tertiary 
Level Multi-Specialities Hospitals on surplus Railway land that not operationally required.   
 
MoH&FW had appointed M/s Infrastructure Leasing & Financial Services (IL&FS) as a 
Transaction Advisor for the said project and was entrusted to carry out Market Assessment and 
Project Structuring and Transaction Advisor submitted its Report in September 2011.  
 
In 2016, MoH&FW advised to Ministry of Railways to enter into MoUs with the respective State 
Government, where they wish to offer excess vacant land for establishment of healthcare 
facilities as Government of India does not engage in establishing various health facilities in States 
directly.  It only provides technical and financial assistance to the State Governments to 
strengthen their healthcare system, including for physical infrastructure.

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (c) OF UNSTARRED 
QUESTION NO. 1253 BY SHRI AJIT KUMAR BHUYAN ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA ON 
11.02.2022 REGARDING PROGRESS OF DOUBLE TRACK WORK IN NFR 
 
(a) to (c): New Bongaigaon – Kamakhya via Goalpara (176 km) doubling project was 
sanctioned in 2015-16. Anticipated cost of the project is `2950 crore. An expenditure of `1965 
crore has been incurred till date and an outlay of `310 crore has been provided for 2021-22 and 
`500 crore has been proposed for 2022-23.  
 
New Bongaigaon – Abhyapuri (17.49 km) section has been commissioned. Works have 
been taken up in remaining length in available land. 
 
 The completion of Railway project depends on various factors like quick land acquisition by 
State Government, forest clearance by officials of forest department, shifting of infringing utilities, 
statutory clearances from various authorities, geological and topographical conditions of area, law 
and order situation in the area of project site, number of working months in a year for particular 
project site due to climatic considerations etc. All these factors affect the completion time of the 
project. As such, confirmed completion time of project cannot be ascertained at this stage. 
Nevertheless, every effort is being made to execute the project expeditiously. 
 
Average annual Budget allocation for Infrastructure projects and safety works, falling fully/ 
partly in North Eastern Region , during 2014-19 has been enhanced to `5,531 crore per year 
from `2,122 crore per year during 2009-14, which is 161% more than average annual Budget 
allocation during 2009-14. These allocations have been increased to `4,909 crore in Financial Year 
2019-20 (131% more than the average annual Budget allocation of 2009-14) and `4,669 crore in 
Financial Year 2020-21 (120% more than the average annual Budget allocation of 2009-14). For 
Financial Year 2021-22, highest ever budget outlay of `7,292 crore has been provided for these 
projects, which is 244% more than the average annual Budget Outlay of 2009-14 ( `2,122 crore per 
year). 
 
During 2009-14, 333 km sections (66 km New Line, 257 km Gauge conversion and 10 km 
Doubling) falling fully/ partly in North Eastern Region including Assam have been commissioned 
at an average rate 66.6 km per year. 
 
During 2014-21, 1356 km sections (270 km of New Line, 972 km of Gauge Conversion and 
114 km Doubling) falling fully/ partly in North Eastern Region including Assam have been 
commissioned at an average rate 193.71 km per year, which is 191% more than commissioning 
during 2009-14 (66.6 km per year).

DISBURSEMENT OF FUNDS UNDER PM-KISAN  
 
1259. SHRI VIJAY  PAL SINGH  TOMAR: 
 
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS WELFARE be pleased to state: 
 
(a) The quantum of funds disbursed, the number of beneficiaries identified under the Pradhan 
Mantri Kisan SammanNidhiYojana (PM-KISAN) and the number of the beneficiaries 
being benefited under the same till date; 
 
(b) whether any payments to farmers are pending, if so, the details thereof; and 
 
(c)  whether Government intends to provide additional income support to farmers, if so, the 
details   thereof? 
 
ANSWER 
 
MINISTER OF AGRICULTURE AND FARMERS WELFARE 
 
(SHRI NARENDRA SINGH TOMAR) 
 
(a): Under PM-KISAN Scheme, all the landholding farmer families, subject to certain 
exclusion criteria related with higher income status, are eligible to get benefit of the Scheme.  
 As on 08.02.2022, more than 11.78 crore beneficiaries have been given the financial 
benefits of approximately Rs. 1.82 lakh crore under the Scheme through various installments.  Out 
of them, 48.04 lakhwere found to be ineligible.  Therefore, effectively, there are approximately 
11.30 crore eligible beneficiaries under the Scheme. 
 
(b): PM-KISAN Scheme is a continuous and ongoing Scheme. Under the Scheme, the 
responsibility to identify the beneficiaries and upload their correct and verified data on PM-
KISAN Portal lies with the respective State/UT Government. Thereafter, these data go through 
various levels of verification and validation including Aadhaar/PFMS/Income Tax database. 
Consequent upon such verification and validation, the benefits of the Schemes are passed to 
eligible beneficiaries directly into their bank accounts through DBT.  
 
(c): At present, there is no such proposal to provide additional income support under PM-
KISAN Scheme.

(a) & (b):  As on 01.04.2021 across Indian Railways, 484 Railway projects (187 New 
Line, 46 gauge Conversion and 251 Doubling) of 51,165 Km length, costing 
approx. `7.53 
lakh crore are in different stages of planning/sanction/execution, out of which, 10,638 Km

Zonal Railway wise details of Railway projects including cost, expenditure and outlay are 
made available in public domain on Indian Railways website i .e. www.indianrailways.gov.in 
>Ministry of Railways>Railway Board >About Indian Railways >Railway Board 
Directorates >Finance (Budget) >Rail Budget/Pink Book (Year)> Railway wise Works 
Machinery and Rolling Stock Programme. 
 
Budget outlay has been provided to the projects in a rationalized manner and budget has been 
allotted to the projects which are in advance stage of completion, priority projects, important 
New Line & National projects, executable & important Gauge conversion projects and the    
projects which are important from the throughput enhancement considerations. Thus, focused 
attention is given in fund allotment, rather than thinly spreading the resources without 
commensurate results. 
 
Since 2014, there has been substantial increase in Budget allocation and commensurate 
commissioning of projects. The Average Annual Budget allocation in the Indian Railways for 
New Line, Gauge Conversion and Doubling works during 2014-19 has increased to `
26,026 
crore per year from `11,527 crore per year during 2009-14, which is 126% more than average 
annual budget outlay of 2009 -14. The Annual budget allocation for these Projects for 
Financial Year 2019-20 was `39,836 crore (246% more than average annual budget allocation 
during 2009-14) and `43,626 crore in Financial Year 2020 -21 (278% more than the Average 
Annual Budget allocation during 2009 -14). For Financial year 2021 -22, highest-ever budget 
outlay of `52,398 crore has been provided for these works, wh ich is 355% more than average 
annual budget outlay of 2009-14.

The completion of any Railway project(s) depends on various factors like quick land 
acquisition by State Government, forest clearance by officials of forest department, 
deposition of cost share by State Government in cost sharing projects, priority of projects, 
shifting of infringing utilities, statutory clearances from various authorities, geological and 
topographical conditions of area, law and order situation in the area of project(s) site, numbe r 
of working months  in  a year for particular project site due to climatic conditions etc. and all 
these factors affect the completion time of the project(s) due to which the confirmed time 
frame for completion of projects cannot be ascertained at this stage. However, Railways is 
making all the efforts for expeditious completion of projects.  
 
(c):  Railway projects are sanctioned Zonal Railway wise and not State-wise or district-
wise as Indian Railways’ projects may span across various State boundaries.

PLANS TO UTILISE VACANT LAND OF  
RAILWAY FOR COMMERCIAL PURPOSES 
 
 
       1261.  DR. KANIMOZHI NVN SOMU: 
   
              Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to state: 
(a) whether Government has plans to utilise the vacant railway land for commercial purposes 
to provide livelihood for unemployed educated youths and wife or kith and kin of 
deceased employees of Railways; 
(b) if so, the details thereof; and 
(c) the steps taken by Government to support the families of the deceased employees of 
Railways and unemployed youth? 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF RAILWAYS, COMMUNICATIONS AND 
ELECTRONICS & INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY 
 
(SHRI ASHWINI VAISHNAW) 
 
(a) :       No, Sir. 
 
(b) :       Does not arise. 
 
(c):      As per extant policy, Financial Assistance/Ex-gratia Compensation is provided to 
the families of Railway employees who die in harness in performance of their bonafide 
official duties.  Widow Pass facility is also extended to such families as per rules. 
Besides, there are provisions for appointment on compassionate grounds of the 
dependents of the deceased Railway Employees who loses their lives in the course of 
duty or die in harness or are medically incapacitated.  
            As regards support to unemployed youth, open market recruitment to posts in 
Railways is conducted through examinations by various agencies like UPSC (for 
Gazetted posts), SSC, RRBs /RRCs (for Non Gazetted posts).

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (c) OF UNSTARRED 
QUESTION NO. 1263 BY DR. NARENDRA JADHAV ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA 
ON 11.02.2022 REGARDING KISAN RAIL PROJECT 
 
 (a) and (b): The data regarding expenditure incurred on operating any type of train 
services, including Kisan Rail trains, is not maintained.  However, since the launch of Kisan 
Rail service on 7 th August 2020 and upto 31 st October, around 1535 service have been 
operated, transporting approximately 5 lakh tonnes of consignments on 136 routes.  Major 
loading stations for Kisan Rail services are Devlali, Sangola, Savda, Raver, Nagarsol, Yeola, 
Dahanu Road, Lingampet Jag ityal, Farukkabad, Indore, Kherwadi, Lasalgaon, Niphad, 
Nuzvid, Vizianagram, etc, and major unloading locations are Agartala, Adarshnagar (Delhi), 
Changsari, Chitpur, Fatuha, Malda Town, Gour Malda, New Jalpaiguri, New Guwahati, 
Muzaffarpur, Jorhat and Shalimar, etc.   
Potential circuits for movement of Kisan Rail services are identified in consultation with 
Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare and Agriculture/Animal Husbandry/ Fisheries 
Departments of State Governments as well as local bodies and agencies, Mandis etc., and 
based on demand, rakes are provided on priority for running of Kisan Rail services. Kisan rail 
services have been operational in the states of Andhra Pradesh, Assam, Bihar, Delhi, Gujarat, 
Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Nagaland, Punjab, Rajasthan, Telangana, Tripura, 
Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal and the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir.   
 
 
(c): Stoppages of Kisan rail trains are provided at stations where unhindered and efficient 
loading/unloading operation can be performed, so as to avoid multiple handling and to minimize 
damage to the commodities.  Also, the consignments are stacked properly and tied securely as 
per requirement to avoid lateral movement during transit and save the perishables from 
damages.

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (d ) OF UNSTARRED 
QUESTION NO. 1264 BY DR. NARENDRA JADHAV ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA 
ON 11.02.2022 REGARDING KISA N RAILS IN REMOTE AREAS 
 
 
 (a) & (b): Since the launch of Kisan Rail service on 7 th August 2020 and upto 4 th 
February, 2022 Kisan Rail services have operated on 159  routes  in the S tates of Andhra 
Pradesh, Assam, Bihar, Delhi, Gujarat, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Nagaland, 
Punjab, Rajasthan, Telangana , Tripura, Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal and the Union Territory 
of Jammu & Kashmir.  Major loading stations for Kisan Rail services are Devlali, Sangola, 
Savda, Raver, Nagarsol, Yeola, Dahanu Road, Lingampet Jag ityal, Farukkabad, Indore, 
Kherwadi, Lasalgaon, Niphad, Nuzvid, Vizianagram, etc, and major unloading locations are 
Agartala, Adarshnagar (Delhi), Changsari, Chitpur, Fatuha, Malda Town, Gour Malda, New 
Jalpaiguri, New Guwahati, Muzaffarpur, Jorhat and Shalimar, etc.   
Cold storage facilities are not p rovided by Indian Railways at the loading/unloading stations.  
However, in order to facilitate storage of perishables, temperature controlled Perishable 
Cargo Centres have been established at Nashik, Singur, New Azadpur, Raja Ka 
Talab/Varanasi, Ghazipur and Fatuha. In addition, cold storage Reefer Park has been 
developed at Inland Container Depot, Dadri and a cold storage facility has been established at 
Rai, Sonipat.   
 
(c) & (d):   Potential circuits for movement of Kisan Rail services are identified in 
consultation with Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare and Agriculture/Animal 
Husbandry/Fisheries Departments of State Governments as well as local bodies and agencies, 
Mandis etc.   
 
Zonal Railways are regularly co-coordinating with stakeholders to explain to them the 
benefits of transporting perishables through Kisan Rail,  such as access to bigger market, time 
bound delivery, no minimum limit on booking, multi consignor, multi consignee, multi 
commodity, reduced wastage, etc.   As a result of these efforts, many stations which were not 
catering to Parcel traffic previously (such as Yeola, Savda, Sangola and Kherwadi) are now 
accessible to Kisan Rail trains

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 1265 
ANSWERED ON 11.02.2022 
STEADY INCREASE IN RAILWAY PASSENGERS 
 
1265  SHRI SYED ZAFAR ISLAM: 
 
 Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to state:         
(a) whether the number of passengers travelling between Delhi and Pt. Deen Dayal 
Upadhyay Junction has been steadily increasing and if so, the details in this regard; and 
(b)  whether Government proposes to run more new trains or DMUs keeping in view the said 
increase, if so, the details thereof and if not, the reasons therefor? 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF RAILWAYS, COMMUNICATIONS AND  
ELECTRONICS & INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY  
 
(SHRI ASHWINI VAISHNAW) 
 
(a)  During 2019-20, approximately 5.10 lakh passengers travelled between Delhi and Pt. Deen 
Dayal Upadhyay Junction which is 3.87% less than the number of passengers who travelled 
during the corresponding period of previous year. 
 
(b) At present, Delhi- Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyay sector is being served by 56 pairs of 
Mail/Express trains, which are considered adequate to cater to the present level of traffic. 
Introduction of new train between Delhi and Pt. Deen Dayal Upadhyay is not feasible, at 
present, due to operational constraints including terminal constraints in Delhi area and path 
constraints on sections enroute. However, introduction of new services is an on-going process 
on Indian Railways.

STATEMENT REFERRED TO IN REPLY TO PARTS (a) TO (c) OF UNSTARRED QUESTION 
NO.1268 ASKED BY SHRI NEERAJ DANGI ANSWERED IN RAJYA SABHA ON 11.02.2022 
REGARDING RAILWAY WORKS IN RAJASTHAN 
 
(a) and (b): Railway projects are sanctioned Zonal Railway-wise, not State- wise, as Indian Railways’ 
projects may span across State boundaries. However, as on 01.04.2021, 12 doubling projects covering a 
total length of 2,522 km and costing `27,651 crore are in different stages of 
Planning/Sanction/Execution, out of which, 142 km length have been commissioned. An expenditure of  
`4400 crore has been incurred upto March, 2021. 
 
16 electrification projects covering a total length of 3357 km falling fully/partly in the State of 
Rajasthan are also in different stages of Planning/Sanction/Execution.  
 
Rajasthan is covered by Northern Railway, Western Railway, North Western Railway, West 
Central Railway, and North Central Railway Zones of Indian Railways. The details of allotment of 
funds and expenditure project-wise and Zonal Railway wise are made available in public domain on 
Indian Railways website i.e. www.indianrailways.gov.in> Ministry of Railways> Railway Board> 
About Indian Railways>Railway Board Directorates> Finance (Budget), Pink Book (year)>Railway 
wise Works Machinery & Rolling Stock Programme. 
 
Since 2014, there has been substantial increase in budget allotment for infrastructure projects. 
Average Annual Budget allocation for infrastructure projects and safety works, falling fully/partly in 
State of Rajasthan during 2014-19, has been enhanced to `
2951 crore per year from `682 crore per year 
during 2009-14, which is 333% more than average annual budget outlay of 2009-14.  These allocations 
have been increased to `4686 crore in Financial year 2019-20 (587% more than the average annual 
Budget allocation of 2009-14) and `
4582 crore in Financial year 2020-21 (572 % more than the average 
annual Budget allocation of 2009-14).  For Financial year 2021-22, highest ever budget outlay of `6006 
crore has been provided for these projects, which is 781 % more than the average annual Budget Outlay 
of 2009-14 (`682 crore per year). 
 
During 
2014-21, 1947 Km sections (176 km  New line, 637 km Gauge conversion and 1134 km 
Doubling) falling fully/partly in the State of Rajasthan have been commissioned at an average rate of 
278.14 km per year, which is 74% more than commissioning during 2009-14 (159.6 Km/year)         
  
(c):Timely completion of Railway project(s) depends on various factors like quick land acquisition by 
State Government, forest clearance by officials of forest department, shifting of infringing utilities, 
statutory clearances from various authorities, geological and topographical conditions of area, law and 
order situation in the area of project(s) site, number of working months in a year for particular project 
site due to climatic conditions, etc. and all these factors affect the completion of the project(s). 
Therefore, confirmed timeline for completion of the project(s) cannot be given at this stage. 
Nevertheless, Railways is making all efforts for expeditious completion of project(s).

 Sensitizing the contractor about BHEL’s safe work practices & procedures to be

KARAIKKUDI – KANYAKUMARI RAILWAY LINE PROJECT  
 
1270. DR. ANBUMANI RAMADOSS: 
  
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to state: 
 
(a) whether Government has any proposal to revive the shelved Karaikkudi -  Kanyakumari 
East Coast Railway (ECR) line project in the future; and  
 
(b) if so, the details thereof and if not, the reasons therefor?  
 
 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF RAILWAYS, COMMUNICATIONS AND 
ELECTRONICS & INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY 
 
(SHRI ASHWINI VAISHNAW)

Tiruneleveli and Nagarcoil. On the above route double line already exists from Virudunagar to 
Tiruneleveli and doubling work of Tiruneleveli to Kanniyakumari has been taken up.  
 
 Survey for Karaikudi to Kanniyakumari via Ramanathapuram and Tuticorin along the 
coast was completed in two parts in the year 2011-12. However, same could not be taken 
forward being financially unviable.

l the Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to state:

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA 
MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS 
 
RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO. 1272 
ANSWERED ON 11.02.2022 
 
SAMASTIPUR JUNCTION 
 
1272 #   SHRI RAM NATH THAKUR: 
            Will the
 Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to state:  
(a) whethe
r it is a fact that the number of tracks at Samastipur Junction under Samastipur 
Division remains inadequate;  
(b) whether it is also a fact that due to inadequate number of tracks the trains coming from 
Muzaffarpur, Darbhanga, Rosra and Barauni are made to wait for hours at Karpurigram, 
Muktapur, Dasuya and Ujiarpur respectively; and   
(c) if so, whether Government is considering to develop this station as terminal by utilizing the 
land lying vacant on either sides of Karpurigram railway station? 
 
 
ANSWER 
MINISTER OF RAILWAYS, COMMUNICATIONS AND  
ELECTRONICS & INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY 
 
 
(SHRI ASHWINI VAISHNAW)   
(a) No, Sir.  However, the traffic on the Indian Railway s’ network has constantly been growing 
and accordingly Railway infrastructure is planned based on the future growth.      
(b) No, Sir.  The time table of trains for the division has been made in such a way so as to ensure 
that there is no unreasonable detention to trains at any location. However, since the traffic on 
Indian Railways is dynamic and continuously fluctuating due to combination of several factors 
such as failures, unusual occurrence, fog, traffic fluctuation and train running out of path, it leads 
to temporary congestion.  
(c) No, Sir. Samastipur Junction is already a major terminal.

and  
 
(c) if so, the details thereof?  
 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR TEXTILES  
(SMT. DARSHANA JARDOSH) 
 
(a) to (c): The Government has approved setting up of 7 (Seven) PM Mega Integrated Textile 
Region and Apparel (PM MITRA) Parks in Greenfield/Brownfield sites to develop world class 
infrastructure including plug and play facility with an outlay of Rs.4445 Crore for a period of seven 
years upto 2027-28. The PM MITRA Parks Scheme shall be implemented on pan-India basis and is 
intended for holistic development of the textile sector.  The selection of PM MITRA parks will be done 
through challenge method. Chief Secretaries of all State Governments including Kerala have been 
requested to file applications for setting up PM MITRA Parks in their respective states by 15.3.2022.

HIGH COTTON PRICES 
 
1276.  SHRI SUSHIL KUMAR GUPTA: 
 
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to state:  
 
 
(a) whether Government is aware that high cotton prices this season has become a subject of 
conern to the domestic textile industry;  
 
(b) whether it is also a fact that the raw material prices are not only increasing but there is also a 
shortage in availability; and  
 
(c) if so, the steps being taken by the Ministry to address these issues facing the textile industry? 
 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR TEXTILES  
(SMT. DARSHANA JARDOSH) 
 
 
(a): Ministry is constantly engaged with various stakeholders across the entire cotton value 
chain in respect of the prices of cotton and cotton yarn to harmonize their interest. Prices are 
affected by market forces of demand and supply. In addition, cotton being an internationally 
traded commodity, its price is also affected by the price in the international market. 
 
(b): India is a cotton surplus country wherein production is more than consumption. The 
current cotton season 2021-22 commenced with an estimated carry over stock of 73.20 lakh 
bales & the estimated production is 362.18 lakh bales. The estimated consumption is only     
338 lakh bales. Thus, there is sufficient availability of cotton in the country. 
 
(c): Does not arise in view of (a) & (b) above

UNSTARRED QUESTION NO-1278 
ANSWERED ON- 11/02/2022 
 
STEPS TO PROMOTE HANDLOOM INDUSTRY 
 
1278.  DR. AMEE YAJNIK: 
 
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to state:  
 
 
(a) the details of steps taken by Government to promote handloom industry in the last three 
years, State-wise;  
 
(b) whether Government has made any policy to support small weavers during pandemic; and  
 
(c) if so, the details thereof?  
 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR TEXTILES  
(SMT. DARSHANA JARDOSH) 
 
(a) to (c): The Govt. of India, Ministry of Textiles is implementing the following schemes to 
develop and promote handlooms and welfare of the handloom weavers across the country:  
 
1. National Handloom Development Programme; 
2. Raw Material Supply Scheme; 
 
Under the above schemes, financial assistance is provided for raw materials, purchase of 
looms and accessories, design innovation, product diversification, infrastructure development, 
marketing of handloom products in domestic and overseas markets, MUDRA loans etc.  
 
To overcome the challenges /problems being faced by handloom workers  due to covid-19 
pandemic, the Government has taken following proactive steps for their welfare and to promote 
the handloom sector across the country:  
a) Steps have been taken to on -board weavers on Government e -Market place to enable 
them to sell their products directly to various Government Departments and 
organizations. So far about 1.50 Lakh weavers have been on-boarded on the GeM portal. 
440

 
b) To enhance productivity, marketing capabilities and ensure better incomes, 1 33 
Handloom Producer companies have been formed in different States. 
c) Under Weaver MUDRA Scheme, financial assistance is provided as follows: 
i) Margin money assistance 
- @ 20% of loan amount, subject to maximum of Rs. 25,000/- per weaver,  
- @ 20% of loan amount, subject to maximum of Rs. 20.00 lakh (@ Rs. 2.00 lakh 
for every 100 weaver/worker) per handloom organization,  
ii) Interest subvention upto 7% for 3 years; and  
iii) Credit Guarantee on loans for 3 years. 
 
d) Design Resource Centres have been set up in Weavers’ Service Centres at Delhi, 
Mumbai, Varanasi, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Bhubaneswar, Guwahati and Kancheepuram, 
through National Institute of Fashion Technology with the objective to build and create 
design-oriented excellence in the Handloom Sector and to facilitate weavers, exporters, 
manufacturers and designers access design repositories for sample/product improvisation 
and development.  
e) To promote marketing of handloom products, Handloom Export Promotion Council has 
been organizing International Fairs in virtual mode. During the year 2020 -21,                
12 handloom fairs were organized in virtual mode. Besides, domestic marketing even ts 
were also organized in different parts of the country for the weavers to market and sell 
their products.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA

RAJYA SABHA 
UNSTARRED QUESTION NO-1280 
ANSWERED ON- 11/02/2022 
 
SUPPORT FOR TECHNOLOGY UPGRADATION IN TEXTILE SECTOR 
 
1280.  SHRI K.J. ALPHONS: 
 
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to state:  
 
 
(a) the support being provided for technology upgradation in the textiles sector;  
 
(b) the support being provided for preservation of skills in tribal communities in textile manufacturing; 
and  
 
(c) how many tribal children have been trained in traditional tribal textile manufacturing with assistance 
from the Ministry? 
 
 
 
ANSWER 
 
THE MINISTER OF STATE FOR TEXTILES  
(SMT. DARSHANA JARDOSH) 
 
 
(a): Ministry of Textiles is providing capital investment subsidy for eligible investment in 
technology upgradation across textile manufacturing sector under Amended Technology Upgradation 
Fund Scheme (ATUFS) implemented since 2016.  Financial support is also provided under National 
Handloom Development Programme for upgradation of looms and accessories to handloom weavers.  
Various technology upgradation assistance and improved toolkits are provided to handicraft artisans 
under National Handicraft Development Programme.  The new technologies developed by Central Silk 
Board R&D institutes are transferred to the stakeholders by providing financial assistance to the State 
Sericulture Departments through beneficiary oriented components under Silk Samagra Scheme. 
 
(b) & (c): SAMARTH (Scheme for Capacity Building in Textile Sector), umbrella skill 
development scheme implemented by Ministry of Textiles promotes skilling and skill upgradation in 
traditional sectors of handlooms, handicraft, sericulture and jute.    Under SAMARTH, preference is 
given to the marginalized social groups like women, SC/ST, differently-abled persons, minorities, 
persons from the BPL category and 115 Aspirational Districts notified by the NITI Aayog.  A total of 
1,712 Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries have been provided skill training in traditional textile sector 
courses (Handloom -966, Handicraft-518, Sericulture -199 and Jute- 29) under SAMARTH.  In 
addition, a total of 4,820 tribal artisans have benefitted through 238 training programmes conducted by 
O/o Development Commissioner (Handicrafts) since 2018-19.

(क ) :  भारत  कफनटेक  और  निनजटल  भुगतान  नवाचार  में  नवश्व का  नेतृत्‍व कर  रहा  है । अम  भारतीय  ने  
निनजटल  भुगतान  को  ऄपनाकर  हमारे  कफनटेक  पाररनथथनतकी  तंत्र में  ऄत्यनधक नवश्वास कदखाया है और  
अगे भी ईम्मीद है कक  हम  आस क्षेत्र में  नवकास  करना  जारी  रखेंगे  । 
 
नपछले  तीन  वषों के  दौरान  भारत  में  निनजटल  भुगतान  लेनदेन  में  जबरदथत  वृनि दजज की  गइ है। असान  
और  सुनवधाजनक निनजटल  भुगतान  मोि  जैसे  भारत  आंटरफ े स फॉर  मनी -यूननफाआि पेमेंट्स आंटरफ े स 
(भीम -यूपीअइ), तत्काल भुगतान  सेवा (अइएमपीएस ), प्रीपेि पेमेंट  आंथूमेंट्स (पीपीअइ), एनइटीसी  
(नेशनल  आलेक्ट्रॉननक टोल  कलेक्शन ) ने  पयाजप्त वृनि दजज की  है और  व्यनि से व्यनि (पी2पी) के  साथ -
साथ  व्यनि से व्यापारी ( पी2एम ) भुगतानों में  वृनि करक े  निनजटल भुगतान  पाररनथथनतकी तंत्र को  
पररवर्ततत कर  कदया है । साथ  ही मौजूदा  भुगतान  मोि  जैसे  िेनबट कािज , क्र े निट कािज , एनइएफटी  
(नेशनल  आलेक्ट्रॉननक फ ं ि ट्रांसफर), अरटीजीएस  (ररयल -टाआम ग्रॉस सेटलमेंट ) में  भी तीव्र गनत से वृनि 
हुइ है। भीम -यूपीअइ नागररकों  के  पसंदीदा भुगतान  मोि  के  रूप में  ईभरकर  सामने  अया है और  
जनवरी  2022 में  8.31 लाख  करोड़ रुपये  मूलय के  461.71 करोड़ निनजटल  भुगतान  लेनदेन का  ररकॉिज  
हानसल  ककया  है । 
 
नपछले  तीन  नवत्तीय वषों के  दौरान  और  चालू नवत्तीय वषज में  ककए  गए निनजटल  भुगतान  लेनदेन  की  क ु ल  
संख्या नीचे कदए ऄनुसार  है:

# नोट: निनजटल  भुगतान  मोि  नजनक े  अंकड़े नलए  गए : भीम -यूपीअइ, अइएमपीएस , एनएसीएच , 
एइपीएस और  एनइटीसी , िेनबट कािज , क्र े निट कािज , एनइएफटी , अरटीजीएस , पीपीअइ और  ऄन्य ।

# नोट: निनजटल  भुगतान  मोि  नजनक े  अंकड़े नलए  गए : भीम -यूपीअइ, अइएमपीएस , एनएसीएच , 
एइपीएस, एनइटीसी , िेनबट कािज , क्र े निट कािज , एनइएफटी , अरटीजीएस , पीपीअइ और  ऄन्य । 
* ऄनंनतम  िेटा । 
 
(ग) : भारत  में  निनजटल भुगतान  पररदृश्य बड़े पैमाने पर  पररवतजन  के  दौर  से गुजर  रहा  है। भारतीय  
ईपभोिाओं ने  निनजटल प्रौद्योनगकी के  प्रनत ऄत्‍यनधक रुनच  कदखाइ है, नजससे  निनजटल  भुगतान  
ऄवसंरचना  का  तेजी  से नवकास  हुअ है। निनजटल  भुगतान  का  ईपयोग करने  के  लाभ  आस प्रकार हैं: 
 
i. भुगतान  का  त्वररत और  सुनवधाजनक  तरीका : नकद  के  नवपरीत , भीम -यूपीअइ, अइएमपीएस  
जैसे  निनजटल  मोि  का  ईपयोग करक े  तुरंत  लाभाथी  के  खाते में  पैसा ट्रांसफर ककया  जा  सकता  है। 
आसक े  ऄलावा , भीम -यूपीअइ मोि  का  ईपयोग करक े  कोइ  भी मोबाआल  फोन  का  ईपयोग करक े  
निनजटल  लेनदेन  को  सक्षम कर  सकता  है, वह भी वीपीए (वचुजऄल  प्राआवेट एड्रेस) नामक  इ-मेल  
ककस्‍म  के  पते के  साथ  । 
ii. नवत्तीय समावेशन  में  वृनि: निनजटल  भुगतान  को  सक्षम करने  के  नलए  व्यनि को  बैंक  खाते की  
अवश्यकता होती है, जहां  से वह भुगतान  कर  सकता  है या थवीकार  कर  सकता  है। आसनलए , 
निनजटल  भुगतान  को  ऄपनाने से नवत्तीय समावेशन  भी बढ़ रहा  है ऄथाजत  ऄनधक  बैंक  रनहत  
व्यनियों को  बैंककग  प्रणाली के  ऄंतगजत लाया  गया है। 
iii. कोनवि -19 महामारी  के  दौरान  बढ़ी थवीकायजता : कोनवि  19 महामारी  ने  हमें निनजटल  भुगतान  
का  एक  और  लाभ  नसखाया है, थवाथ्य सेवा को  सक्षम बनाने  में  आसकी  भूनमका।  यूपीअइ क्यूअर 
कोि , एनएफसी  ( ननयर फीलि कम्युननक े शन) सक्षम कािज  जैसे  संपक ज  रनहत  भुगतान  मोि  से 
सुसनित  निनजटल  भुगतान  सामानजक  दूरी के  "नए  मापदंि " का  पूरक बने हैं । कोरोना  वायरस  
संकट  के  दौरान  निनजटल  भुगतान  ने  ऄथजव्यवथथा को  चालू रखा  हुअ है और  लोगों  की  वायरस  से 
संपक ज  कम करने  में  मदद   कर  रहा  है। 
iv. भुगतान  में  नवाचार  को  बढ़ावा देना : भारत  का  थवदेशी रूप से नवकनसत  भीम -यूपीअइ मोबाआल  
ऐप का  ईपयोग करक े  निनजटल  भुगतान  को  सक्षम बनाता है जो  सावजभौनमक  आलेक्ट्रॉननक 
भुगतान , कम नकदी  वाले  समाज  और  नवत्तीय समावेशन  के  लक्ष्यों को  प्राप्त करने  से सीधे जुड़ा 
हुअ है। थमाटजफोन  ऄपनाने, भारतीय  भाषा आंटरफ े स और  आंटरनेट  और  िेटा के  सावजभौनमक  
ऄनभगम में  वृनि करक े  ऄगली  पीढ़ी की  ऑनलाआन  तत्काल भुगतान  की  सुनवधा सुकर  करने  के  
नलए  भीम -यूपीअइ मानक एपीअइ (एनललक े शन  प्रोग्राममग आंटरफ े स) के  एक  सेट का  ईपयोग कर  
रहा  है । 
v. राष्ट्रीय आलेक्ट्रॉननक टोल  संग्रह (एनइटीसी ): राष्ट्रीय आलेक्ट्रॉननक टोल  संग्रह (एनइटीसी) प्रणाली 
ग्राहक को  अरएफअइिी (रेनियो फ्रीक्व ें सी अआिेंरटकफक े शन) प्रौद्योनगकी का  ईपयोग करक े  टोल  
पर  रुक े  नबना  राजमागज  पर  एनइटीसी सक्षम टोल  ललाजा  पर  आलेक्ट्रॉननक भुगतान  करने  में  सक्षम 
बनाती  है। एनइटीसी लेनदेन  की  मात्रा ऄप्रैल, 2017 में  74.1 लाख  से बढ़कर जनवरी , 2022 में  
2,310.1 लाख  हो गइ है। 
vi. भारत  नबल  भुगतान  प्रणाली: भारत  नबल भुगतान  प्रणाली (बीबीपीएस) ईपभोिाओं को  आंटरनेट  
बैंककग , मोबाआल  बैंककग , मोबाआल  ऐप, भीम -यूपीअइ अकद जैसे कइ  चैनलों  के  माध्यम से एक  
ऄन्‍तर  प्रचालनीय और  असानी  से सुलभ  अवती और  नबल  भुगतान  सेवा प्रदान करती  है। 
462

वतजमान  में , भारत  भर  में  20 श्रेनणयों के  नबलसज  को  बीबीपीएस पर  जोड़ा जा  रहा  है। बीबीपीएस 
में  नपछले  क ु छ वषों में  महत्वपूणज वृनि देखी गइ है, बीबीपीएस लेनदेन  की  मात्रा ऄक्टूबर, 2017 
में  7.6 लाख  से बढ़कर जनवरी , 2022 में  627.1 लाख  हो गइ है। 
vii. क्यूअर कोि  प्रौद्योनगकी को  तेजी  से ऄपनाना : नवमुद्रीकरण के  बाद, क्यूअर कोि  के  नलए  
थवीक ृ त बुननयादी  ढांचे में  जबरदथत  वृनि देखी गइ है। नतीजतन , क्यूअर अधाररत  भुगतान  
तेजी  से बढ़ रहे  हैं। ईपयोनगता नबल , ईंधन , ककराना , भोजन, यात्रा और  कइ  ऄन्य श्रेनणयों का  
भुगतान  करने  के  नलए  कोइ  भी क्यूअर कोि  को  थक ै न  ककया  जा  सकता  है। 
viii. बेहतर  गनत और  समय  पर  निलीवरी : नकद  भुगतान  के  नवपरीत , जो  ऄपने वाहक  की  गनत से 
यात्रा करता  है, निनजटल  भुगतान  वथतुतः तात्कानलक  हो सकता है, भले  ही प्रेषक और  प्राप्‍तकताज  
एक  ही शहर , नजले  या देश में  हों या न  हों। 
ix. सरकारी  प्रणाली में  बढ़ी पारदर्तशता: पहले  नकद  भुगतान  " लीक े ज " ( भुगतान  जो  पूणज रूप से 
प्राप्तकताज तक  नहीं  पहुंचता है) और  " घोस्‍ट" ( नकली ) प्राप्तकताजओं के  तहत थे , नवशेष रूप से 
सरकारी  हथतांतरण  द्वारा सामानजक सुरक्षा लाभों  के  संदभज में  । ऄब, भुगतान  के  निनजटल  तरीकों  
के  माध्यम से लाभ  सीधे लनक्षत लाभाथी ( प्रत्यक्ष लाभ  हथतांतरण ) के  खाते में  थथानांतररत  कर  
कदए जाते हैं। नवत्त वषज 2021-2022 के  दौरान  312 योजनाओं  के  तहत 4.6 लाख  करोड़ रुपये  
के  मूलय का  लेनदेन  िीबीटी के  माध्यम से ककया  गया है। 
x. सुरनक्षत और  नवश्‍वसनीय : नकद  भुगतान  प्राप्तकताजओं को  ऄक्सर न  क े वल  ऄपने  भुगतान  प्राप्त 
करने  के  नलए  काफी  दूरी तय करनी  पड़ती है, बनलक  वे चोरी  के  नलए  भी नवशेष रूप से 
संवेदनशील  होते हैं । भारत  भर  में  निनजटल  भुगतान  बहुत सुरनक्षत हैं - लेनदेन करने  के  नलए  
प्रमाणीकरण के  कइ  थतरों  की  अवश्यकता होती है। 
xi. निनजटल  भुगतान  का  वैश्वीकरण: भारत  का  थवदेशी रूप से नवकनसत  भीम -यूपीअइ ( भारत  
आंटरफ े स फॉर मनी -यूननफाआि पेमेंट्स आंटरफ े स) और  रुपे  कािज  निनजटल  भुगतान  को  सक्षम करने  
के  नलए  नवश्व थतरीय  ललेटफॉमज  हैं। वैनश्वक टेक -कदग्गज, गूगल ने  भी यूएस फ े िरल ररजवज  को  
निनजटल  भुगतान  के  नलए  भारत  के  यूपीअइ जैसे  ललेटफॉमज  की  नसफाररश  की  है। 
xii. ईधार : पहले  ऄथजव्यवथथा में  नकदी  का  वचजथव बना  रहता  था  नजससे  नागररक  की  नवत्तीय छाप 
थथानपत  करने  की संभावना  कम हो जाती  है। ऄब निनजटल भुगतान  क्र े निट सनहत औपचाररक  
नवत्तीय सेवाओं तक  नागररकों  की  पहुंच बढ़ाते हैं। छोटे पैमाने  के  ईद्यनमयों की  ऄक्सर 
औपचाररक  क्र े िेट तक  सीनमत  पहुंच होती है। बैंक  और  नइ  ऋण देने  वाली  क ं पननयां  निनजटल  
लेनदेन  पूवजवृत्‍त की  समीक्षा करने  और  नागररकों  को  ऋण देने  में  सक्षम होंगी। 
xiii. कफनटेक  को  बढ़ावा देना : कफनटेक  ने  पूरे निनजटल  भुगतान  पाररनथथनतकी  तंत्र को  लाभानन्वत 
करते  हुए पारदशी , सुरनक्षत, तेज  और  ककफायती  लागत  के  तंत्र को  सक्षम करक े  निनजटल  लेनदेन  
की  वृनि में  महत्वपूणज भूनमका  ननभाइ  है। कफनटेक  ने  व्‍यनि-से-व्‍यनि  (पी2पी) के  साथ -साथ  
व्‍यनि-से-व्‍यापारी (पी2एम ) भुगतानों में  वृनि करक े  निनजटल भुगतान   पेमेंट  पाररनथथनतकी  
तंत्र को  बदल  कदया है।

*109.  श्री संजय  ससह  : 
   
 क्या  इलेक ् ‍ट्रॉननकी  और  सूचना  प्रौद्योनगकी मंत्री यह बताने  की  क ृ पा करेंगे  कक : 
 
(क)    क् ‍या यह सच  है कक  निनजटल इंनिया योजना  ग्रामीण जनता  को  निनजटल साक्षरता  प्रदान करने  
में नवफल  रही  है और  यह वषष  2021 तक  अपने  ननधाषररत  लक्ष् ‍यों को  भी प्राप्‍त नहीं  कर  पाई है और  इसे  
नननध की  कमी  की  समस् ‍या का  सामना  भी करना  पड़ रहा  है;   
 
(ख)   यकद हां, तो तत्‍संबंधी  ब्‍यौरा  क् ‍या है और  इसक े  क् ‍या कारण  हैं;  
 
(ग)       क् ‍या यह भी सच  है कक  सरकार  ने  निनजटल इंनिया योजना  का  कोई  मूल् ‍यांकन  नहीं

‘निनजटल इंनिया’ योजना  की  प्रभावकाररता  के  संबंध  में कदनांक  11.02.2022 को

(क ) और  (ख) : भारत  सरकार  के  इलेक्ट्रॉननकी  और  सूचना  प्रौद्योनगकी मंत्रालय (एमईआईटीवाई) ने  वषष  
2014 में 'निनजटल इंनिया' कायषक्रम  शुरू  ककया , नजसका  उद्देश्य निनजटल अनभगम, निनजटल समावेशन , 
निनजटल सशक ् ‍तीकरण  और  निनजटल नवभाजन  दूर  करने  का  सुननश् ‍चय करते  हुए भारत  को  निनजटल 
रूप से  सशक्त  समाज  और  ज्ञान-आधाररत  अथषव्यवस्था में पररवतर्ततत करना  है । संक्षेप  में, इसका  नमशन  
यह सुनननित  करना  कक ‍ निनजटल प्रौद्योनगककयां प्रत्येक नागररक के  जीवन  में सुधार  करें ; भारत  की  
निनजटल अथषव्यवस्था का  नवस्तार  करें , देश में रोजगार  और  वैनिक  निनजटल प्रौद्योनगककयों का  सृजन  
करें  । 
 
निनजटल इंनिया कायषक्रम  तीन  प्रमुख नवजन  क्षेत्रों पर  क ें कित है, जैसे कक  प्रत्येक नागररक  के  नलए  एक  
मुख्‍य उपयोनगता के  रूप  में निनजटल अवसरंचना , मांग पर  शासन  और  सेवाएं  और  नागररकों  का  
निनजटल सशक ् ‍तीकरण  । यह एक  व्यापक कायषक्रम  है और  इसकी  कई  उपलनधधयां  हाल  ही में वैनिक  
कोनवि महामारी  के  दौरान  भारत  के  लचीलेपन  के  नलए  नजम्मेदार थीं। इस  कायषक्रम  में नवनभन्न क ें िीय 
मंत्रालयों/नवभागों और  राज्यों/क ें ि शानसत  प्रदेशों की  कई  पररयोजनाएं  शानमल  हैं नजनमें  अन्य बातों के  
साथ -साथ  प्रधानमंत्री ग्रामीण निनजटल साक्षरता  अनभयान  (पीएमजीकदशा) योजना  शानमल  है नजसका  
उद्देश्य ग्रामीण भारत  में निनजटल साक्षरता  प्रदान करना  है। कायषक्रम  ने  सरकार  और  नागररकों  के  बीच 
की  दूरी  को  काफी  कम कर  कदया है और  पारदशी  और  भ्रष्टाचार मुक्त तरीक े  से  लाभाथी  को  सीधे  पयाषप्त 
सेवाएं  प्रदान करने  में भी मदद की  है। 
 
इलेक्ट्रॉननकी  और  सूचना प्रौद्योनगकी मंत्रालय ( एमईआईटीवाई) फरवरी  2017 से  6 करोड़ ग्रामीण 
पररवारों  को  शानमल  करक े  ग्रामीण भारत  में निनजटल साक्षरता  की  शुरुआत  करने  के  नलए  
पीएमजीकदशा योजना  लागू  कर  रहा  है। अब तक  पीएमजीकदशा योजना  के  कायाषन्वयन  के  नलए  क ु ल  
1488 करोड़ रुपये  जारी  ककए  गए हैं। अब तक , क ु ल  लगभग  5.56 करोड़ उम्मीदवारों को  नामांककत  
ककया  गया है और  4.69 करोड़ उम्मीदवारों को  प्रनशनक्षत ककया  गया है, नजनमें से  3.48 करोड़ 
उम्मीदवारों को  उक्त योजना  के  तहत नवनधवत  प्रमानणत ककया  गया है । 
 
(ग) और  (घ) : निनजटल इंनिया कायषक्रम  के  तहत सभी  प्रमुख योजनाओं  के  प्रभाव का  मूलयांकन  आम 
तौर पर  एक  स्वतंत्र तीसरे  पक्ष  के  माध्यम से  ककया  जाता है, जो ननष्पक्ष  स्वतंत्र मूलयांकन  सुनननित  
करने  के  नलए  योजना  के  कायाषन्वयन  में शानमल  नहीं  होता है। पीएमजीकदशा योजना  के  कदशा-ननदेश  
तीसरे  पक्ष  ( पक्षों ) के  माध्यम से  योजना  के  प्रभाव मूलयांकन  का अध्ययन  नवननधाषररत  करते  हैं। इन

␀ाथिमकता- ␀ा␀ ␀व␀रत ␀सचाई लाभ काय␀␀म (एआईबीपी) प␀रयोजना␀ क␀ पहचान क␀ गई ह␀

(II) वाटरशेड िवकास घटक  
 
भूिम संसाधन िवभाग (डीओएलआर) पीएमक े एसवाई क े  वाटरशेड िवकास घटक को 
काया␀ि␀वत कर रहा है। काय␀␀म के  अंतग␀त शु␀ ␀कए गए काय␀कलाप␀ म␀ ␀रज ␀े␀ उपचार, जल 
िनकासी लाइन उपचार, मृदा और नमी संर␀ण, जल संचयन संरचना , आजीिवका सहायता 
काय␀कलाप और अ␀य वाटरशेड काय␀ शािमल ह␀। िपछले तीन वष␀ क े  दौरान इस काय␀␀म क े 
अंतग␀त 5.60 लाख हे␀टेयर क␀ सुर␀ा␀मक ␀सचाई ␀मता वाली लगभग 2.40 लाख जल संचयन 
संरचना␀ का सृजन /कायाक␀प ␀कया गया है। ड␀␀यूडीसी क े  अंतग␀त अब तक ␀ा␀ त क␀ गई 
वा␀तिवक उपलि␀धय␀ और िपछले तीन वष␀ क े  दौरान जारी क␀ गई क े ␀␀ीय सहायता तथा ␀कए 
गए ␀य का रा␀य-वार ␀यौरा अनुबंध-VI(क) और VI(ख) म␀ ␀दया गया है। 
 
(III) ␀ित बूंद अिधक फसल:  
 
क ृ िष एवं ␀कसान क␀याण िवभाग (डीए एंड एफड␀␀यू) देश क े  सभी रा␀य␀ म␀ वष␀ 2015-16 
से ␀धान मं␀ी क ृ िष ␀सचाई योजना (पीएमक े एसवाई-पीडीएमसी) क े  ␀ित बूंद अिधक फसल घटक 
का काया␀␀वयन कर रहा है। पीडीएमसी ␀क␀म सू␀म ␀सचाई अथा␀त ि␀प और ␀␀␀कलर ␀सचाई 
␀णािलय␀ क े  मा␀यम से क ृ िष ␀तर पर जल उपयोग द␀ता बढ़ाने पर क े ि␀␀त है। पीडीएमसी क े  
अंतग␀त अब तक 59.97 लाख हे␀टेयर ␀े␀ को सू␀म ␀सचाई क े  अंतग␀त लायागया है।  
 
िपछले तीन वष␀ क े  दौरान जारी क␀ गई रा␀य-वार क े ␀␀ीय सहायता और पीडीएमसी ␀क␀म 
क े  मा␀यम से सू␀म ␀सचाई क े  अंतग␀त अब तक कवर ␀कए गए ␀े␀ का ␀यौरा अनुबंध -VII(क) 
और VII(ख) म␀ ␀दया गया है।

कृ␀ष ␀ौ␀यो␀ग␀कय␀ पर अपने ␀ान को उ␀नत करने के ␀लए ␀न␀न␀ल␀खत इले␀␀ॉ␀नक मी␀डया के

से ␀सा␀रत ␀कए जाते ह␀। क ृ␀ष के तकनीक␀ पहल ुओं पर ␀कसान␀ और अ␀य ␀हतधारक␀ के बीच

गया है, िजसम␀ बीपीकेपी के तहत ␀ाकृ␀तक खेती के अंतग␀त 1.0 लाख हे␀टेयर ␀े␀ शा␀मल है।  
 
(ग) आं␀ ␀देश सरकार (जीओएपी) ␀वारा रा␀य म␀ एपी क␀ य ु␀नट␀ मैने␀ ड नेचर फा␀म␀ग (एपीसीएनएफ) को

 आं␀ ␀देश सरकार ने एएंडसी ␀वभाग के तहत स␀चवालय ␀तर पर एक अलग ␀ाक ृ␀तक कृ␀ष ␀वभाग 
बनाया है। 
 आं␀ ␀देश म␀ ␀ाक ृ␀तक खेती काय␀␀म के काया␀␀वयन क␀ पहल के ␀लए आं␀ ␀देश सरकार ने रयथ ु 
सा␀धकारा सम␀ था (आरवाईएसएस) को अ␀नवाय␀ ␀कया। 
 आरवाईएसएस क␀ रा␀य ␀तर पर एक सम␀प␀त रा␀य प␀रयोजना ␀बंधन इकाई (एसपीएमय ू), िजला 
␀तर पर िजला प␀रयोजना ␀बंधन इकाई (डीपीएमय ू) और गांव ␀तर पर सामुदा␀यक संवग␀ है। 
 रा␀य ␀तर␀य ट␀ओट␀ , िजला ␀तर␀य ट␀ओट␀ और ␀ाम ␀तर␀य पर जाग␀कता अ␀भयान का संचालन 
करना। 
 ␀␀श␀␀त ␀कसान␀/साम ुदा␀यक ␀वशेष␀ ␀यि␀तय␀ (सीआरपी) क␀ सहायता से ␀कसान␀ को माग␀दश␀न

 म␀हला ␀वयं सहायता सम ूह ␀ाम ␀तर पर और गांव␀ के सम ूह म␀ एक जुट करने , योजना बनाने ,

 म␀हला ␀वयं सहायता सम ूह␀ को शा␀मल करते ह ुए ␀कसान-वार ␀ाक ृ␀तक कृ␀ष काय␀ योजना तैयार

तकनीक‍को‍प्रोत्‍ सादहत‍करने‍पर‍षवचार‍कर‍रही‍है , यदि‍हां, तो‍तत्‍ संबंधी‍ब्‍ यौरा‍क्‍ या‍है; और   
 
(ख) ‍क्‍ या‍ सरकार‍ लघ ु‍ और‍ सीमांत‍ ककसानों‍ को‍ प ु

तत्‍ संबंधी‍ब्‍ यौरा‍क्‍ या‍है‍और‍यदि‍नहीं , तो‍इसक े ‍क्‍ या‍कारण‍हैं ?

(ि) ‍‍क ृ षि‍राज्‍ य‍सरकार ‍का‍षविय‍है । तथाषप, क ृ षि‍उत्‍ पािन‍को‍बढाने‍क े ‍शलए ‍भारत‍सरकार‍िेिभर‍
में‍ लघु‍और‍सीमांत ‍ककसानों‍सदहत  सभी‍ककसानों‍क े ‍शलए ‍आधुननक‍क ृ षि‍प्रौद्योगगकी‍को‍बढावा‍िेने ‍
क े ‍शलए‍कई‍क े न्‍द‍ रीय‍प्रायोजित‍और‍क े न्‍द‍ रीय‍क्षेत्र‍योिनाओं‍क े ‍द्वारा‍राज्‍ य‍सरकारों ‍को‍सहायता‍प्रिान‍
करती‍है‍और‍उसे‍स ुगम‍बनाती‍है।‍ककसानों‍ ‍में ‍आधुननक‍क ृ षि‍प्रौद्योगगकी‍ को‍बढावा‍िेने‍क े ‍शलए‍
क ु छ‍प्रमुख‍क े न्‍द‍ रीय‍योिनाओं‍में‍क ृ षि‍प्रौद्योगगकी‍प्रबंधन‍एिेंसी‍(एटीएमए)‍योिना ,‍क ृ षि‍षवस्‍ तार‍को‍
िन‍ संचार‍ माध्‍ यम‍ की‍ सहायता, ककसान‍ कॉल ‍ सैंटर, क ृ षि-क्‍ लीननक‍ और‍ क ृ षि-व्‍ यवसाय‍ क े न्‍द‍ र, क ृ षि‍

(पीर्ीएमसी); बागवानी‍क े ‍समजन्‍दवत‍षवकास‍हेत ु‍शमिन  आदि‍सजममशलत‍हैं। 
 
(ख)‍उपरोक्‍ त‍क े ‍अनतररक्‍ त, अभी‍तक‍भारतीय‍क ृ षि‍अन ुसंधान‍पररिि ‍(आईसीएआर)‍क े ‍तत्‍ वावधान‍में‍
729‍ क ृ षि‍ षवज्ञान‍ क े न्‍द‍ र‍ िेिभर‍ में‍ षवशभन्‍द‍ न‍ जिलों‍ में‍ स्‍ थाषपत‍ ककए‍ गये‍ हैं‍ िहां‍ लघु‍ और‍ सीमांत ‍
ककसानों‍सदहत  सभी‍ककसानों  में‍ आधुननक‍क ृ षि‍प्रौद्योगगकी‍की‍िानकारी‍का‍प्रसार‍और‍प्रििमन‍करने‍

है, िहां‍ सतत‍ अन ुसंधान‍ प्रकिया‍ क े ‍ पररणामस्‍ वरूप‍ नई‍ प्रौद्योगगककयां/फसल‍ ककस्‍ में/क ृ षि‍ पद्धनतयां‍

␀वषय:  ␀बहार म␀ जलवायु अनु
कूलन कृ␀ष:  
1139. ␀ी अ␀खलेश ␀साद ␀संह:  
␀ या कृ␀ष एवं ␀कसान क␀ याण मं␀ी यह बताने क␀ कृपा कर␀गे ␀क:  
(क) ␀ या सरकार ␀बहार म␀ जलवाय ु अनु
कूलन कृ␀ष को बढ़ावा देने के ␀लए ␀कसी योजना का 
काया␀␀ वयन कर रह␀ है, य␀द हां, तो त␀ संबंधी ␀ यौरा ␀ या है; और  
(ख) ␀ या ␀बहार के  कुछ िजल␀ का चयन जलवाय ु अनु
कूलन कृ␀ष के ␀लए ␀कया गया है, और 
य␀द हां, तो ऐेसे चयन का मानदंड ␀ या है? 
उ␀ तर

अनुबंर्-क  
 
किनांक  11.02.2022 को  उत््‍तर किए जाने के  णलए णनयत राज््‍य सभा अतारांककत  प्रश्‍न संख््‍या 1150 के  भाग 
(क ) के  उत््‍तर में उणल्लणित अनुबंर् 
 
णिलौनों  के  घरेलू उत्पािन को  बढाने/ आयात में कमी  लाने के  णलए सरकार  द्वारा उठाए गए किम  
 
(i) णविेश  व्‍यापार  महाणनिेशालय  (िीजीएफटी) ने अणर्सूचना संख््‍या 33/2015-2020, किनांक  02.12.2019 
के  जररए प्रत््‍येक  िेप  की  नमूना  जांच का  अणर्िेश किया है तथा गुिवत््‍ता जांच के  सफलतापूवधक  पूरा  होने 
तक  णबक्री की  अनुमणत  नहीं िी जाती है। असफल रहने  पर  आयातक  के  िचे  पर  या तो िेप  को  वापस  
भेज किया जाता है अथवा नष््‍ट कर  किया जाता है।  
 
(ii) फरवरी , 2020 से णिलौनों - एचएस कोि - 9503 पर  मूल सीमा शुल््‍क  (बीसीिी) को  20 प्रणतशत से 
बढाकर  60 प्रणतशत कर  किया गया है। 
 
(iii) सरकार  ने किनांक  25/02/2020 को  णिलौना  (गुिवत््‍ता णनयंत्रि) आिेश, 2020 जारी ककया  है णजसक े 
जररए किनांक  01/01/2021 से णिलौनों  को  भारतीय मानक  ब््‍यूरो (बीआईएस) के  अणनवायध  प्रमािन के  
तहत लाया गया है। गुिवत््‍ता णनयंत्रि आिेश (क््‍यूसीओ) के  अनुसार , प्रत््‍येक  णिलौने  को  संगत भारतीय 
मानक  की  आवश्‍यकताओं  को  पूरा  करना  होगा तथा उस पर  बीआईएस (अनुरूपता  मूल््‍यांकन ) णवणनयम , 
2018 की  स््‍कीम -1 के  अनुसा र बीआईएस से लाइसेंस के  तहत मानक  णचह्न लगा होगा। यह क््‍यूसीओ 
भारतीय णवणनमाधताओं  के  साथ-साथ भारत में अपने  णिलौनों  का  णनयाधत करने  के  इच्‍छ ु क णविेशी  णवणन माधताओं 
पर  लागू है। 
 
(iv) णशक्षा मंत्रालय ने टॉयक ै थॉन 21 का  आयोजन ककया  जो णिलौना  उद्योग द्वारा अनुभव  की  जा रही समस््‍याओं 
का  णमलकर  समार्ान करने  के  णलए 6 मंत्रालयों और णवभागों द्वारा ककया  गया अनोिा  प्रयास था। इस 
कायधक्रम के  णलए 1.2 लाि पंजीकरि  प्राप्‍त हुए हैं तथा 17,000 से अणर्क णवचार  प्रस््‍तुत ककए  गए हैं 
और 50 लाि रुपए  तक  का  पुरस््‍कार  जीतने के  णलए 13900 टीमें बना ई गई हैं।

थे। 11 राज््‍यों ने ‘भागीिार राज््‍यों’ के  रूप  में भाग णलया। 25 लाि से ज््‍यािा िशधकों  ने इस मेले में भाग 
णलया। िुणनयाभर  के  103 ख््‍याणत प्राप्‍त वक््‍ताओं ने 41 सम्‍मेलनों /वेबीनार  में उपणस्थणत िजध कराई।

1151. डा. सणममत  पात्रा: 
 
क्या वाणिज्य और उद्योग मंत्री यह बताने की  क ृ पा करेंगे  कक : 
 
(क ) भारत  में व्यवसाय की  सुगमता  में सुर्ार करने  के  णलए क े न्द्र और राज्यों द्वारा राज्य-वार  कौन -कौन  
से  सुर्ार ककए  गए हैं;  
(ख) भारत  में राज्यों के  णलए व्यवसाय सुगमता  की  रैकक ं ग का  णनर्ाधरि ककस  तरह  से  ककया  जाता है; 
और  
(ग) क्या भार त में राज्यों के  णलए व्यवसाय की  सुगमता  की  रैकक ं ग में सुर्ार की  आवश्यकता है, यकि 
हां, तो क्यों और क ै से?   
 
उत्तर 
वाणिज्य और उद्योग मंत्रालय में राज्य मंत्री 
(श्री सोम  प्रकाश) 
 
(क ): उद्योग संवर्धन और आंतररक  व्‍यापार  णवभाग (डीपीआईआईटी) क ें रीय मंत्रालयों/णवभा गों, राज््‍यों और 
क ें र शाणसत  प्रिेशों (यूटी) के  साथ  णमलकर  िेश में व्‍यावसाणयक  वातावरि  को  बेहतर  बनाने के  णलए 
णवणभन्द््‍न सुर्ारों का  नेतृत्‍व करता  है। डीपीआईआईटी ने वर्ध 2015 में व्‍यवसाय  सुर्ार कायध  योजना 
(बीआरएपी ) नामक  एक  गणतशील  सुर्ार कायध  शुरु ककया  है जो णनर्ाधररत सुर्ार मानिंडों के  
कायाधन्द््‍वयन के  आर्ार पर  िेश के  सभी  राज््‍यों और क ें र शाणसत  प्रिेशों को  रैंकक ं ग प्रिान करता  है। 
इन सुर्ारों का  फोकस  मौजूिा णवणनयमों  और प्रकक्रयों को  सरल  एवं कारगर  बनाने तथा गैरजरूरी  
आवश््‍यकताओं  और प्रकक्रयाओं को  हटाने पर  है। इस  कायध  योजना में सुर्ार के  अनेक  क्षेत्र शाणमल  हैं 
जैसे  णनवेश इनेबलसध , ऑनलाइन ससंगल  सवंडो णसम्‍टम, भूणम प्रबंर्न तथा भूणम और सम्‍पणत्त का  
अंतरि , णनमाधि परणमट  इनेबलसध , श्रम णवणनयम  इनेबलसध , पयाधवरि  पंजीकरि  इनेबलसध , णनरीक्षि 
इनेबलसध , करों  का  भुगतान, उपयो णगता परणमट  प्राप्‍त करना  आकि। सभी  राज््‍यों और क ें र शाणसत  
प्रिेशों ने इस  कायध  में सकक्रय रूप  से  भाग णलया और उनक े द्वारा कायाधणन्द्वत सुर्ारों को  बीआरएपी  
पोटधल  (https://eodb.dpiit.gov.in/) पर  िजध ककया  गया है।  
(ख): संबंणर्त राज््‍यों और क ें र शाणसत  प्रिेशों द्वारा कायाधणन्द्वत प्रत्‍येक  सुर्ार के  संबंर् में प्रयोक््‍ताओं/पेशेवरों  
से  प्राप्‍त फीडबैक  के  आर्ार पर  राज््‍यों और क ें र शाणसत  प्रिेशों को  व्‍यवसाय  सुर्ार कायध  योजना के  
तहत  रैंकक ं ग िी जाती है।  
(ग): व्‍यवसाय  सुर्ार कायध  योजना के  तहत  ककए  जाने वाले  मूल्‍यांकन  प्रकक्रया की  प्रक ृ णत लगातार  णवकणसत  
होने की  है तथा यह सुणनणित  करती  है कक  णनरंतर  परामशध  प्रकक्रया के  जररए प्रत्‍येक  चरि में सुर्ार 
ककए  गए जाएं। राज््‍यों/ क ें र शाणसत  प्रिेशों, मंत्रालयों/णवभागों तथा णवणभन्द््‍न उद्योग संघों  के  साथ

(ग) उक्त सीमेंट कारखानों  में क ु ल ककतने  लोग कायधरत  हैं;  
(घ) क्या सरकार  के  पास ककसी  सीमेंट संयंत्र की  स्थापना का  कोई  प्रस्ताव णवचारार्ीन है; और  
(ड.) यकि हां, तो तत्संबंर्ी राज्य-वार  ब्यौरा क्या है और इसकी  वतधमान णस्थणत क्या है? 
 
उत्तर 
वाणिज्य और उद्योग मंत्रालय में राज्य मंत्री 
(श्री सोम प्रकाश) 
  
(क ) से (ङ): इस णवभाग में उपलब्र् जानकारी  के  अनुसार राजस्थान सणहत िेश में णस्थत सीमेंट 
इकाइयों  का  ब्यौरा अनुबंर् में सूचीबद्ध कक या गया है। 
 
 णपछडे  और ग्रामीि क्षेत्रों में णस्थत इकाइयों , राज्य-वार  उत्पािन या सीमेंट संयंत्रों 
में कायधरत  लोगों की  संख्या का  ब्यौरा क ें द्रीय स्तर पर  नहीं रखा जाता है। 
 
  
 
 णपछले  तीन वषों के  िौरान िेश में क ु ल सीमेंट उत्पािन णनम्नानुसार है:

(ख) यकि हां, तो तत्संबंर्ी ब्यौरा क्या है;   
(ग) क्या सरकार  ने णवगत पांच  वर्षों में भारत में भारतीय द्वारा िायर ककए  गए पेटेंट में वृणि पर  गौर 
ककया  है;  
(घ) यकि हां, तो तत्संबंर्ी ब्यौरा क्या है;   
(ड.) क्या सरकार  के  पास िेश में पेटेंट िायर करने  की  प्रकक्रया को  आसान बनाने  के  णलए  कोई  
योजना/प्रस्ताव हैं; और  
(च) यकि हां, तो इस संबंर् में की  गई कारधवाई  का  ब्यौरा क्या है?
